messages:
Sam: Heads up — sdk-publish CI failing on main. Typegen generated a new field name that broke TS exports and the sample-app onboarding e2e. Log snippet:
```
error TS2339: Property 'sessionTimeout' does not exist on type 'ClientOptions'.
at src/sdk/index.ts:45:17
```

ci-bot: publish-job #742 failed (exit 1) — logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/742

Maya: oh no, that was from the typegen regen this morning. It renamed `session_timeout` -> `sessionTimeoutMs` in the generated models. That is a breaking rename, not just a cosmetic change. :facepalm:

Raj: If it's a rename it's semver-major territory. Did the release pipeline/semantic-release guardrails pick this up? I didn't see a breaking-change note in the changelog.

Liam: The new typegen config removed the compatibility alias we relied on. We should add a compat shim ASAP so onboarding/sample apps don't break.

Sam: Proposed quick patch to restore compatibility at the SDK surface: 
```ts
// compat-shim.ts
export type ClientOptions = Omit<GeneratedClientOptions, 'sessionTimeoutMs'> & {
  // deprecated: keep old name for one release
  sessionTimeout?: number
}
function mapOptions(o: any) {
  if (o.sessionTimeout !== undefined && o.sessionTimeoutMs === undefined) {
    o.sessionTimeoutMs = o.sessionTimeout
  }
  return o
}
```
I'll open a PR and run a canary publish.

Maya: :thumbsup: please also add a regen post-check that asserts exported type names don't change unexpectedly. This keeps codegen from silently breaking SDKs.

Raj: Agree on the test. Also FYI the sample-app onboarding flow returned a 500 during e2e; same root cause. We should hold the public release until the patch lands.

ci-bot: deploy-gate: release blocked — failing checks.

Liam: I'll cut a patch branch, add the shim + unit test, and run the full matrix. Low-risk change but want at least one extra reviewer.

Maya: :eyes: reviewing now. Also adding a changelog line like `fix(sdk): restore sessionTimeout alias (compat shim)` and a note about the typegen regression.

Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 — includes shim, unit test, and changelog entry. Decision: ship as a patch to restore compatibility and mark the rename as deprecated, then follow up with a proper major in the next cycle if we want the new name.

Raj: Sounds reasonable. Also file a quick postmortem/retro for typegen guardrails so this doesn't slip through again.

Maya: I'll add a CI check to compare exported type names vs previous golden snapshot. Should prevent accidental renames.

ci-bot: patch branch build succeeded (job 759). Tagging preview: v1.8.1-rc.1

Sam: Hotfix published (v1.8.1). Thanks all. I'll draft a short postmortem and an action item to add typegen exported-name checks + changelog enforcement.
